subject: English Comprehension
questionText:
Fill in the blank with the correctly spelt word.

The biologist studied _________ organisms found deep underwater.
solution:
Abyssopelagic [गहरे समुद्री क्षेत्र से संबंधित] is the correct spelling: abyss - o-pelagic, with a double "s" in abyss and a single "l" in pelagic.

It refers to the deep - ocean zone, about 4, 000 - 6, 000 m below the surface.

Abissopelagic uses "i" for "y", abysopelagic has a single "s", and abyssopellagic has a double "l".

Correct sentence: The biologist studied abyssopelagic organisms found deep underwater.

solution:
Antediluvian [अत्यंत पुराना, पुराने ज़माने का] is the correct spelling: ante (before) + diluvian (flood), literally "before the Flood", i.e. very old - fashioned.

Correct sentence: The king ruled with antediluvian authority.

Antidiluvian uses "anti" for "ante", antedeluvian has "e" for "i" in "diluv", and antediluvean ends wrongly in "-ean".
